semiconductor_relevance: High — HIT provides specialized cleaning and preparation equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: HIT designs and manufactures specialized equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on wet stations and display equipment. Their products, such as the Canister Cleaner and Wet Station, are essential for cleaning and preparing semiconductor components. HIT also offers automation solutions and imported safety-enhancing goods like gas detectors.
capabilities: Automation solutions for productivity and safety
